hook.line: Here are my four best AI systems you can build this week.
hook.visual: Presenter centred in a bright room; white rounded title box at top in serif: '4 AI Systems that will put you ahead of all your competition' with a rocket emoji.

beats.what: Talking head with a serif list-promise title box above his head
Title box changes to '1. AI Second Brain' as the first item starts
Cut: a top band appears showing a vault file tree, face stays below
Top band switches to an agent app screen for item two, AI agents
Executive-assistant chat bubbles in the top band, asking about tomorrow's calendar
Content agent: raw clip, red arrow, edited clip side by side
Cut to item three: full AI workflow panel
Five-column workflow board: Scrape, Script, Edit, Post, Analytics
Item four: a terminal showing scheduled cron jobs
Title box returns: 'Comment Community to build out these AI systems'

why_it_works: A numbered promise (4 systems) plus a numbered title per item tells the viewer how far through they are
Each claim gets a real screen of his own setup in the top band, so it reads as proof not opinion
Same framing all video with one consistent caption pill keeps it calm and easy to follow at 3.8 words/s
Save-worthy list content: shares (992) are high relative to likes
weaknesses: 105 s with only 4 cuts and no punches; the face shot barely changes
Top-band screens are small and pass quickly, details are unreadable on a phone
Two asks at the end (comment, then follow) dilute each other
for_robert: Use a numbered title that changes per item, and let Fred carry the number in (holding a sign '1', '2', ...) so the list structure becomes a recurring gag.
